name: Metal
description: Dense, strong and often conductive industrial materials with very low fuel value.
examples: Reactive, conductive, magnetic and structural metals.

name: Silicate
description: Stone, glass and ceramic mineral family; generally hard, heat tolerant and low in stored energy.
examples: Silica, clay, stone, insulating minerals, glass and ceramics.

name: Carbon
description: Carbon-rich minerals, hydrocarbons and related synthetics with moderate-to-high stored energy.
examples: Solid/liquid fuels, graphite, lubricants, polymers and solvents.

name: Organic
description: Plant- and biomass-derived matter; generally low density and strength with moderate stored energy.
examples: Woody plant, fibrous plant and organic biomass.

name: Water
examples: Fresh water, brines, reactive process waters and coolants.

name: Salt
description: Mineral salts and evaporites, including the catalogue approximation for some sulfate/phosphate minerals.
examples: Sulfurous and phosphate minerals and fertilizers.

name: Volatile
description: Chemically volatile compounds that tend to exist as gas under ordinary conditions.
examples: Gas fuels, inert gases, oxidizers and atmospheric mixes.
